name: caption-with-intent
description: Open toolchain for the Caption with Intention design system: interchange format, reference spec implementation, renderers, and an AI analyzer.

scripts.build: npm run build -w cwi-core && npm run build -w cwi-web && npm run build -w cwi-cli && npm run build -w cwi-mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:py
scripts.release:dry: npm run release:check && npm publish --workspaces --dry-run --access public
